PR: Requeue on poll interval, not pipeline TTL, when RTC is disabled [closed; labels backport release-1.20]
### Description of your changes

Fixes https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/issues/6617

When realtime composition is disabled we should maintain the old behavior of requeuing after the poll interval, not after the function pipeline TTL expires.
